page.name: content/shortcut
page.position: after actions/button and the other content/* pages, before Utilities

componentSet.name: Shortcut
componentSet.defaultVariant: Appearance=Plain, Size=md, Platform=Mac (the top-left variant of the set; columns md, sm, lg)

exposedInstances.Key 1: instance of _Shortcut/Key (text property Key#149:20, default ⌘ on Mac, Ctrl on Other)
exposedInstances.Key 3: instance of _Shortcut/Key (Key, default K; hidden unless Show key 3)
exposedInstances.note: The Plugin API refuses componentPropertyReferences on instance sublayers, so set-level Key 1/2/3 text properties could not drive the nested texts; the nested instances are exposed instead and also show their own Appearance.

bindings.variant (container): itemSpacing → space/content/xs (Keycap) or 0 (Plain); opacity → opacity/muted (synced in percent, VariableID:145:3) (Plain); explicit mode of Components = Size
bindings._Shortcut/Key text: fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing → shortcut/font-size, shortcut/line-height, shortcut/letter-spacing; fill → shortcut/foreground; font Inter Medium (literal)
bindings._Shortcut/Key Keycap frame: fill → color/surface/subtle; stroke (inside, strokesIncludedInLayout) → color/border/default; strokeWeight → border/width/default; four corners → radius/control; paddingLeft, paddingRight → space/content/xs; paddingTop, paddingBottom 0; minWidth → shortcut/cap-min-width

shortcut/foreground.value: alias color/content/primary (VariableID:7:10) in the three modes
shortcut/foreground.note: Bound by the key texts and the separators; the Button rebinds its Shortcut trailing item to button/foreground (VariableID:90:13).

adapterVariables.note: Formerly _ggbrick shortcut size (149:1570, variables 149:1572 to 149:1575) and _ggbrick shortcut (149:1571, variable 149:1576), deleted on 2026-10-14 after the regrouping.

specification.note: Built on 2026-10-14, then one fix (keys table first column widened to 250 px so long names do not wrap; keycap zoom redrawn at ×8 on a 300 px board); both folded into the builder. Uses the Wireframe collection (VariableCollectionId:105:1565) and the documentation components _Spec/Callout 115:6 and _Spec/Marker 115:8 of the Utilities page; _Spec/Board 113:17 is the style reference of the boards.

temporary: Parity frames named “_parity <context>” are created at x=-4000 and removed by each measurement run; a “_tmp measure” frame of the first geometry check was removed; none remain (checked on 2026-10-14: the page holds _Shortcut/Key, _Shortcut/Separator, Shortcut and the specification frame only).

fixtures.note: The Button masters still use _Fixture/Shortcut (42:22) on the Utilities page; nothing of the Button was touched. Integration of this master as the Shortcut trailing type of _Button/Trailing (75:14) is the orchestrator's step.

maintenance: 2026-10-14: the six Plain variants re-bound from the mirror variable shortcut/plain-opacity (VariableID:155:874, removed) to opacity/muted (VariableID:145:3), now synced in percent (70) by the token sync; effective opacity 0.7 verified on an instance.

maintenance.change: Blueprint boards: the drawing is centered vertically in each board and the legend elements follow (user review of the wave 1 Figma parity gate, 2026-10-14); the builder script applies the same pass (centerBoards). The Anatomy leaders were shortened (24 px margins) and the Keycap board's dimension rows moved next to the caps, B above the first cap, so that the legend stays inside the board.

Adapter collections regrouped (user review, 2026-10-14): the component adapter variables now live in one hidden collection Components (VariableCollectionId:181:2, modes sm 181:0, md 181:1, lg 181:2, default md): button/icon-drawing 181:3, button/icon-size 181:4, counter/foreground 181:5, shortcut/foreground 181:6, shortcut/font-size 181:7, shortcut/line-height 181:8, shortcut/letter-spacing 181:9, shortcut/cap-min-width 181:10 (size-independent variables carry the same alias in the three modes). Every consumer was rebound and the explicit size modes moved (Button: 564 bindings, 138 mode assignments; Shortcut: 13 bindings, 12 modes; Counter: 12 paints; stale Leading icon overrides on ten specification instances reset and re-applied); the collections _ggbrick button size (74:3), _ggbrick shortcut size (149:1570), _ggbrick counter (149:1548) and _ggbrick shortcut (149:1571) were deleted with no reference left on any page. _ggbrick button style and _ggbrick button state were renamed Components · button style (90:12) and Components · button state (90:2), IDs unchanged, hidden. Checks: the eight variables resolve to the former values in each mode; Button slot geometry re-measured with icon, counter and shortcut trailing items (162 records, 0 failures).

Token collections renamed Foundations · Primitives, Foundations · Brand, Foundations · Appearance and Foundations · Density (IDs and bindings unchanged); the adapter scripts of this component resolve the short axis names to the prefixed ones.

Internal part _Shortcut/Nested (278:1153) created (authoring/adapters/figma/nested-parts.plugin.js). User decision at the wave 1 Figma parity review (2026-10-26, option 2): inside a host, a Counter or Shortcut must not show its Size; Counter and Shortcut keep their Size for use on their own. Equal to Shortcut in 18 contexts × 3 sizes × 4 variants (216 cases, 0 differences). Shortcut itself is unchanged apart from its description, which points to the nested part.

Library pages (user decision): the master and its internal parts moved to the section Shortcut of the Content library page (IDs kept, instances linked; library-pages.plugin.js); the component page keeps the specification, which now links to the section (spec-master-links.plugin.js).
